meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目里没人调用的代码安全删掉,并留下可回退的提交记录。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里堆积了越来越多没人再调用的旧代码,想干净利落地清掉。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if old unused code keeps piling up in your project and you want it gone safely.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描项目里没被引用的代码,用 LSP 确认零引用后按文件分批,交给并行子代理删除,每批单独提交。最后跑类型检查、测试和构建。
howto.when: 当你提到 “remove dead code”、“dead code”、“cleanup” 等关键词,或要求清理未使用代码时触发。可指定文件、目录或符号名缩小范围,默认全项目扫描。

say.text: 扫描整个项目,列出所有没被引用的死代码
say.note: 先出候选清单,LSP 确认后才删

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录下的未使用代码
say.note: 把扫描范围缩小到该目录

say.text: 删掉 unusedFunc,每批单独提交
say.note: 按文件分批,类型检查通过后提交

howto.what_en: After install, Claude scans the project for unused code, confirms zero references via LSP, batches items by file, and delegates removal to parallel sub-agents that each commit separately, then runs typecheck, tests and build.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "remove dead code", "dead code", "cleanup" etc., or ask to clean up unused code. You can narrow scope to a file, directory or symbol; default is a full project scan.

say_en.text: Scan the whole project and list all unreferenced dead code
say_en.note: You get candidates first, removal follows LSP confirmation

say_en.text: Only clean up unused code under src/utils
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory

say_en.text: Remove unusedFunc and commit each batch separately
say_en.note: Batched by file, committed after typecheck passes
